components.name: Primary action

components.html: Release status v0.2.0
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display: inline-flex; gap: .75rem; align-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .75rem 1.25rem; color: var(--washi-light, #faf7f0); font-family: "Alegreya Variable", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: var(--moss-deep, #626851); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(41 40 35 / 18%); clip-path: polygon(0 8%, 96% 0, 100% 88%, 4% 100%); transition: transform 180ms ease-out, background 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-action-primary svg { width: 1.2rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: #555c46; box-shadow: 0 13px 28px rgb(41 40 35 / 24%); transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-.3deg); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #7a3f38); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-action-primary:active { box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgb(41 40 35 / 18%); transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Navigation link

components.html: JourneyPrinciplesDownload
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2rem; align-items: center; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; color: var(--ink, #292823); font-family: "Alegreya Variable", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.1rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -.35rem; left: 0; height: 1px; content: ""; background: var(--moss-deep, #626851); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #7a3f38); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Folded paper
components.description: The main correspondence container with texture, clipped edges, and a visible folded corner.
components.html:
A small exchange

One letter goes to one unrelated stranger, who may send one reply.
components.css: .ds-paper-fold { position: relative; max-width: 30rem; padding: 3rem; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #292823); background: var(--washi-light, #faf7f0); box-shadow: 0 22px 50px rgb(74 65 53 / 15%); clip-path: polygon(2% 5%, 55% 0, 100% 9%, 95% 89%, 58% 100%, 5% 92%, 0 39%); transform: rotate(-.8deg); } .ds-paper-fold::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 22%; height: 24%; content: ""; background: linear-gradient(142deg, transparent 49%, rgb(98 89 77 / 12%) 50%, rgb(229 220 203 / 68%) 51%); } .ds-paper-fold h3 { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-family: "Alegreya Variable", Georgia, serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 560; line-height: .98; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-paper-fold p { max-width: 48ch; margin: 0; font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Terminal proof
components.description: A dark, warm terminal record that stays visually separate from the washi field.
components.css: .ds-terminal-proof { max-width: 30rem; margin: 0; padding: 2rem; color: var(--terminal-ink, #e7e4d8); background: var(--terminal, #171814); box-shadow: 0 16px 35px rgb(41 40 35 / 20%); clip-path: polygon(0 5%, 95% 0, 100% 93%, 8% 100%); transform: rotate(1deg); } .ds-terminal-proof figcaption { margin-bottom: 1rem; font-family: "Alegreya Variable", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 520; } .ds-terminal-proof pre { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid rgb(231 228 216 / 20%); background: #0d0e0c; } .ds-terminal-proof code { font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: .88rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Disclosure row
components.description: A native FAQ disclosure divided by fine branch-colored rules.
components.html:
Is Orifude end-to-end encrypted?

No. Correspondence is encrypted in storage, but the authorized post office decrypts messages for delivery.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { max-width: 42rem; color: var(--ink, #292823); border-top: 1px solid rgb(98 89 77 / 42%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(98 89 77 / 42%); } .ds-disclosure summary { padding: 1.5rem 3rem 1.5rem 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Alegreya Variable", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #7a3f38); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-disclosure p { max-width: 67ch; margin: 0 0 1.75rem; color: #4c473f; font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Download artifact
components.description: A compact platform artifact link paired with a visible checksum prefix.
components.css: .ds-artifact { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: .75rem; align-items: center; max-width: 28rem; padding-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--branch, #62594d); } .ds-artifact a { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: .65rem .75rem; color: var(--washi-light, #faf7f0); text-decoration: none; background: var(--moss-deep, #626851); transition: background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-artifact a:hover { background: #555c46; } .ds-artifact a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #7a3f38); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-artifact code { color: #514b42; font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: .75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Orifude uses a quiet editorial composition built from warm washi, ink, and a single branch that carries the eye between folded letter panels. The page should feel handled and human without becoming nostalgic theater. Broad negative space, horizontal reading, and crisp product evidence keep the material treatment usable.

The visual world is controlled rather than polished smooth. Paper silhouettes vary in angle and scale. Fine crease lines, fiber texture, and sparse moss or clay details give the folds physical character. The supplied wordmark remains clean, the squirrel courier appears only at a meaningful delivery transition, and terminal evidence stays recognizably terminal evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric folded-paper fields instead of a regular card grid.
One irregular ink branch linking major moments without crossing copy.
Warm, low-chroma color with moss actions and clay markers.
Alegreya for the correspondence voice and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for factual copy.
Real TUI proof set against tactile paper, with little motion beyond control feedback.

rules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
rules.body: Moss identifies action and clay identifies small moments. Neither becomes a large decorative field.

rules.name: The Warm Black Rule
rules.body: Use soft ink and terminal black. Avoid neutral blue-black or stark pure black.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Alegreya speaks for invitations and section structure. Atkinson carries evidence and limits. Monospace appears only where the content is a command, checksum, or terminal recording.

rules.name: The Branch Behind Rule
rules.body: The branch may connect and frame sections, but it stays behind content and never crosses a paragraph, control, or focus outline.

rules.name: The Paper Owns the Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe a lifted sheet, proof block, or pressed action. Do not add shadow to ordinary text groups, dividers, or navigation.

rules.name: The Fold, Don't Frame Rule
rules.body: A content container either behaves like a sheet of paper or stays flat in the page flow. Do not substitute generic rounded cards.

dos: Do use broad negative space and varied paper scale to establish hierarchy.
Do keep text horizontal, crisp, and independent of decorative overlap.
Do pair every terminal recording with controls, captions, fallback text, and a transcript.
Do preserve visible focus and collapse transitions to `0.01ms` when reduced motion is requested.
Do use the supplied wordmark and courier artwork without redrawing their identity.
donts: Don't turn the page into a dashboard, a stack of rounded SaaS cards, or a fake browser client.
Don't add gratuitous entrance animation, parallax, drifting paper, or branch motion.
Don't repeat the courier outside a meaningful delivery moment.
Don't use Japanese pastiche, invented cultural claims, or decorative motifs that imply authenticity.
Don't let texture, folds, branch strokes, or low contrast interfere with copy, controls, or verification data.
